# Neo kernel 6.6.144 (`perf`) — 20261117

Kernel set for the POCO F4 GT / Redmi K50 Gaming (`ingres`): `boot.img`, `vendor_boot.img` and `vendor_dlkm.img`, built together. This is the kernel shipped in Neo OS 0.4 Beta.

## What's new
- **Lighter hardening.** Turned off four checks that cost time on every system call or kernel function: `HARDENED_USERCOPY` (`__check_object_size` was #5 in the AutoFDO profile), `MITIGATE_SPECTRE_BRANCH_HISTORY`, `RANDOMIZE_KSTACK_OFFSET` and `ARM64_PTR_AUTH_KERNEL`. Userspace pointer authentication stays on. Stack zero-initialization stays on because Qualcomm's IPA driver relies on it.
- **ThinLTO**, and a re-recorded **AutoFDO profile (v3)**. The profile now also covers the vendor modules (Adreno `msm_kgsl`, display `msm_drm` and `ntsync`), using the new opt-in `AUTOFDO_MODULES` Kbuild switch.
- **AOD wake flash fixed (L10 panel).** DCS `0x51` on this panel takes four bytes, and in hardware AOD the panel runs on the last two. Before leaving AOD, the driver now turns off panel dimming and loads the wake brightness into both halves, so the clock no longer flashes at the AOD level.
- **AOD stays up.** The display driver leaves AOD only when an AOD-flagged layer disappears.

## Measured (kbench, clocks locked, median of 7 runs, compared with 20261115)
| Test | Gain |
|---|---|
| System calls | +26% |
| ntsync (Wine / Proton) | +9–40% |
| Vulkan dispatch (GPU driver) | +9–20% |
| Cross-core wake-ups (sync-wake + game mode) | up to 6× |

18 of 21 benchmarks are faster on average across the A510 / A710 / X2 cores. Large reads from RAM-backed files are about 10% slower; this is being investigated.

# Neo kernel 6.6.144 (`perf`) — 20261115

Kernel set for the POCO F4 GT / Redmi K50 Gaming (`ingres`): `boot.img`, `vendor_boot.img` and `vendor_dlkm.img`, built together. This is the kernel shipped in Neo 24.0 20261115.

## What's new
- **AutoFDO (profile-guided optimisation) ported to 6.6:** hot/unlikely/split text layout, `-ffunction-sections`, `-fsplit-machine-functions`; EL2 (nVHE), vDSO and EFI-stub objects excluded. Profile recorded on-device with CoreSight ETE. Kernel micro-benchmarks +13% / +6% / +7% (A510 / A710 / X2), instruction-cache misses on exec -23%.
- **GPU:** `CP_AHB_CNTL` is programmed for the whole gen7_0 family (Adreno 730), fixing the "AHB bus error" at GPU start.
- **Panel:** backlight restored when leaving doze on L10 panels (no full-brightness flash).
- `-mtune=cortex-a710` (measured: no effect, +2% image size).
- Recovery vendor ramdisk includes `hwid.ko` and `fts_touch_spi.ko`.

changelog:
# Neo kernel 6.6.144 (`perf`) — 20261114

Kernel set for the POCO F4 GT / Redmi K50 Gaming (`ingres`): `boot.img`,
`vendor_boot.img` and `vendor_dlkm.img`, built together from
`kernel/xiaomi/sm8450` @ `6b77d0882077` with the Sony `msm-6.6` base, clang 22
and ThinLTO. This is the kernel shipped in Neo 24.0 20261114.

## What's new
- **ASB-2026-11-02** (November 2026 Android security bulletin) merged: 78 commits
  on top of ASB-2026-10-05.
- **Battery charge counter fixed:** the ADSP reports µAh, but the Xiaomi
  `qti_battery_charger` driver multiplied by 1000 (nAh), overflowing `intval`
  above ~2147 mAh. Above roughly 47% the charge counter went negative in Android
  and batterystats.
- **Panel:** the L10 backlight is restored when leaving AOD, so wake and
  notification pulses no longer flash at full brightness first; the requested
  flat/color-accuracy mode is kept across panel power-off.
- **EVA/CVP:** DSP-side dma-buf fds are resolved through the fastrpc HLOS tgid
  instead of the fastrpc process index.
- **RTL8812AU/8821AU/8814AU** USB Wi-Fi driver (aircrack-ng, monitor mode and
  injection) added to `vendor_dlkm`.
- Default qdisc is `fq` (BBR pacing) and the default zram compressor is `lz4`.
- `uname -v` starts with an English weekday so Settings shows the kernel build
  date instead of "Unavailable".

## Compatibility
- **Requires ROM 20261114 or newer** (`ro.build.date.utc >= 1794646967`): the
  modules were built against this ROM's vendor userspace.
- `perf` profile: KernelSU-Next v3.4.2, NTSync, WALT/EPSS, 120 Hz command mode,
  USB Wi-Fi monitor/injection, USB RNDIS, RTL-SDR (built, not auto-loaded),
  user namespaces/checkpoint-restore.

## Flash
The three images are one set — never flash a subset. Flash in this order into
one slot (`_a` or `_b`), then reboot:

1. `vendor_dlkm` (logical, `/dev/block/mapper/vendor_dlkm_<slot>`) — must fit the
   existing logical partition
2. `vendor_boot` (`/dev/block/by-name/vendor_boot_<slot>`)
3. `boot` (`/dev/block/by-name/boot_<slot>`)

Verify the zip's `sha256`/`size` and each image's `size`/`sha256` against
`manifest.json` before flashing.
